data.body: FORCE_CLOSE: close gate(s) bypassed by user approval — no completion/signature attestation was signed. Reason: "Work is merged and independently verified on main: 6d8ea3143a 'Delete dead bug_close_reason_ok predicate' and c89a2ddcc4 'Delete the dead reconciler _attestation module', both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (Gerrit 1475/1476). Repo-wide greps for bug_close_reason_ok, build_acli_client_from_env and the reconciler _attestation module all return zero, and the 0ac6 routing assertions were re-pointed to JiraBackend.assert_env_ready() and mutation-proved live. Closing via force because the normal path deadlocks, not because validation failed: the completion verifier cannot read git history so it requires the separate-commits criterion be tagged [operator-attested]; adding that tag edits the description, which stales the plan attestation the close gate needs; and a fresh review-plan now correctly BLOCKs on the premise that bug_close_reason_ok no longer exists -- because this ticket already deleted it. Operator decision recorded.". Session: 6ff494b3-b67f-4284-9d1e-818a0b7eecfd.
